name: Segment
category: Packaged CDP with event collection at its core
whyTheyWin: Already installed for event tracking, so it's the default when a team wants to do more with customer data. Switching feels risky.

facts.fact: Acquired by Twilio; deal closed November 2020.

name: Salesforce Data 360
category: Suite CDP inside the Salesforce platform (formerly Data Cloud)
whyTheyWin: Bundled into an existing Salesforce relationship. The economic buyer already trusts the vendor and the procurement path is short.

facts.fact: Data Cloud was renamed Data 360 in October 2025 as part of Agentforce 360.

name: Adobe Real-Time CDP
category: Suite CDP inside Adobe Experience Platform
whyTheyWin: Enterprise marketing orgs standardized on Adobe Experience Cloud. Seen as the safe, all-in-one choice.

name: RudderStack
whyTheyWin: Data engineers like its open-source core and developer-first workflow. Wins when the data team owns the decision outright.

facts.fact: Positions as warehouse-native: customer data routes to the customer's own warehouse.

name: mParticle
category: Packaged CDP, strong in mobile and commerce
whyTheyWin: Deep mobile SDKs and real-time app data. Wins with app-first brands where product teams own the data.

name: Braze
category: Customer engagement platform adding AI decisioning
whyTheyWin: Partner and competitor at once. Already the lifecycle team's daily tool, so its built-in AI decisioning can look like 'good enough' to a marketer.

facts.fact: Acquired AI decisioning company OfferFit (announced March 2025).
Also an activation destination Hightouch integrates with.
